image_title: Cost of the Most Disabling Injuries 1998-2008
summary: This line chart illustrates the cost of the most disabling injuries from 1998 to 2008, measured in billions of dollars. The data points are as follows: 1998 - $37.1 billion, 1999 - $41.1 billion, 2000 - $42.2 billion, 2001 - $44.2 billion, 2002 - $47.4 billion, 2003 - $51.7 billion, 2004 - $50.7 billion, 2005 - $48.6 billion, 2006 - $48.6 billion, 2007 - $53.0 billion, and 2008 - $53.4 billion. The chart shows a general upward trend in costs over the years, with a peak in 2003 and a slight decline in 2004 before resuming an upward trajectory. The source of the data is the Liberty Mutual Research Institute, 2010.
